verdicts.title: Brauer relations in finite groups II - quasi-elementary groups of order p^aq
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: This is the second in a series of papers investigating the space of Brauer relations of a finite group, the kernel of the natural map from its Burnside ring to the rational representation ring. The first paper classified all primitive Brauer relations, that is those that do not come from proper subquotients. verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns Brauer relations in quasi-elementary finite groups of order p^aq, classifying kernels of Burnside-to-representation-ring maps. It says nothing about symmetric Boolean functions, minimal rank bounds, or 2^n/log(n) vs n^2 dimension estimates.

verdicts.title: Boolean lattices in finite alternating and symmetric groups
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Given a group $G$ and a subgroup $H$, we let $\mathcal{O}_G(H)$ denote the lattice of subgroups of $G$ containing $H$. This paper provides a classification of the subgroups $H$ of $G$ such that $\mathcal{O}_{G}(H)$ is Boolean of rank at least $3$, when $G$ is a finite alternating or symmetric group. In this paper we deal with chains of normal subgroups $1 \triangleleft G_1 \triangleleft \cdots \triangleleft G_d =G$, which allow to consider fragments and in particular glider representations.
